notice: This export is a copy of local data for its owner. It transfers no permissions and is not an accepted audit record.

categories.label: Task history
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device
categories.deletion: Delete Task history in Local data (the runtime is stopped, the files are removed, then the runtime restarts)
categories.recovery: Includes ordered inference messages and provider-native opaque continuation/signature blocks bound to the exact route, model and API version, never credentials or proof of analytical acceptance. Incompatible model history is refused, not translated silently. Reimport an earlier export into an empty runtime home; nothing else restores it

categories.label: Runtime logs
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: The runtime writes its log database while it runs, so a copy taken without stopping it is not consistent

categories.deletion: Delete Runtime logs in Local data (the runtime is stopped, the files are removed, then the runtime restarts)
categories.recovery: Not recoverable once deleted; the runtime starts a new log on its next start

categories.label: Runtime state and indexes
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Rebuildable: the runtime recreates its state, indexes and bundled files on start and rebuilds thread indexes from task history

categories.deletion: Delete Runtime state in Local data (the runtime is stopped, the files are removed, then the runtime restarts and recreates them)
categories.recovery: Rebuilt by the runtime on its next start

categories.label: Desktop runtime error log
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device
categories.deletion: Delete the Desktop runtime error log in Local data (the runtime is stopped so the log is closed, the file is removed, then the runtime restarts)
categories.recovery: Reimport an earlier export while no current log exists; otherwise not recoverable

categories.label: Identity session
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Holds Inquello session credentials, which are never exported

categories.deletion: Sign out, or delete the Identity session in Local data: it signs out through the shared service first (revocation attempted), then removes the file

categories.label: Device ID
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Identifies this installation; restoring it on another device would clone the installation identity

categories.deletion: Delete the Device ID in Local data; a new one is created at the next sign-in
categories.recovery: Not recoverable; a new device ID is created at the next sign-in

categories.label: Chromium profile
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Browser-engine caches and storage for the app's own pages; it holds no Task content and is recreated by the app

categories.deletion: Delete the Chromium profile in Local data: storage and caches are cleared through Electron, and files it holds open are recreated while the app runs
categories.recovery: Recreated by the app; nothing to restore

categories.label: Export journal
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Records this device's exports; each export carries its own manifest

categories.deletion: Delete the Export journal in Local data; exported copies are not deleted and leave Inquello's view once it is gone
categories.recovery: Not recoverable; exported copies keep their own manifests

categories.label: Claude API key
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Holds the Claude API key, which is never exported. The dedicated private stdio handoff holds only a volatile generation-bound runtime copy; no credential is written to route metadata, history, logs or runtime config

categories.deletion: Remove the Claude API key in Providers (or delete the Claude API key in Local data); either removes the encrypted file. Inquello sign-out does not remove it
categories.recovery: Not recoverable; enter the key again

categories.label: Runtime configuration
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Initialized by Inquello, then maintained by the runtime configuration writer; plugin/MCP enablement and Task profiles persist across restart. Startup overrides enforce keyring-only credentials; this file holds no credential

categories.deletion: Delete Runtime configuration in Local data (the runtime is stopped, the file is removed, then Inquello initializes safe defaults before the runtime restarts)
categories.recovery: Safe defaults are recreated after deletion; deleted capability settings must be configured again

categories.label: Codex login (OS keyring)

location.entry: Service "Codex Auth", account cli|<hash of the runtime home>, written by the runtime

categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Holds the Codex login (API key or ChatGPT tokens) in the OS keyring; credentials are never exported

categories.deletion: Disconnect the Codex login in Providers: the runtime's logout removes the keyring entry. Inquello sign-out does not remove it
categories.recovery: Not recoverable; log in to Codex again

categories.label: Private work organisation
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device
categories.deletion: Delete Private work organisation in Local data (the runtime is stopped, the files are removed, then the runtime restarts with an empty working store)
categories.recovery: Includes secret-free principal route configurations, Task selections, reasoning/speed revisions, immutable attempt snapshots, native usage/events and automated permission invocation attribution/receipts; never prompts, tool output contents or volatile provider credentials. Unfinished attempts from another runtime remain uncertain; reimport does not replay work. Reimport an earlier export while no working store exists; shared-service Engagements remain on the service, but their local details, folders and private Tasks are not recoverable otherwise

categories.label: Task working folders
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device
categories.deletion: Delete Task working folders in Local data (the runtime is stopped, every Task's working folder and Output folder is removed, then the runtime restarts)
categories.recovery: Reimport an earlier export while no Task working folders exist; otherwise not recoverable

categories.deletion: Not held: the runtime stores Codex logins in the OS keyring only (cli_auth_credentials_store = "keyring"), so a file here is unexpected and blocks real data
